Messages.Author: hamdamcwa
Messages.Body:
A while ago (a thread going back to mid 2001), Leggy asked about
titles and votes.

It was said at the time that vampires that have "static votes" (no
title but votes) have titles.

However, the rulebook seems to have changed in the latest incarnation
(no 6.3.4 anymore). 6.3.3 says:

"Titled Vampires. For each ready titled vampire a Methuselah controls,
she gains extra votes. The number of votes gained depends on the
title. A Methuselah gains:
1 vote for each ready primogen or bishop, and
2 votes for each ready prince, archbishop or baron, and
3 votes for each ready justicar or cardinal, and
4 votes for each ready Inner Circle member.

Other vampires may have votes (as listed on card text) without holding
one of the Camarilla or Sabbat titles listed above. All votes can be
used only when the vampire is ready."

That last paragraph seems to say that votes with no specific titles
(e.g. Synesios) are no longer titles. Is this the correct
interpretation?

The key effect I am thinking of is becoming an Anarch. Can a vampire
with no worded title, but votes (e.g. Synesios) become an Anarch?

If so, will the votes held by the vampire become cumulative with
another title (e.g. (You guessed it) Fee Stakes).

Dave

Apologies if this has been asked recently, but I did a Google search
and this above thread was the best example, if a bit dated.

>> If so, will the votes held by the vampire become cumulative with

titled. otherwise they could use CI to become sabbat/camarilla and get
titles on top of their 'untitled' votes (Amisa, the Ventrue Justicar
with 5 votes... hmmmm....)

See, here's where it is down to interpretation. If independant
vampires are to be treated as if they had a title, would it not make
sense just to put that one sentance that qualifies it (current in
10.3) into the section that lays out the definition of a title.

Seriously, we had what seemed like a 2 hour arguement about this last
week with my playgroup when someone wanted to play a Free States Rant
with Amisa and claimed she still still had 2 votes (It made a
difference since she was only just going ot pass it). I knew
otherwise, but they thought I was making it up - it had never really
come up before. Rule books (Anarchs) were flicked through, and because
there is nothing about it in the "Titles" section (6.3) their word
(eventually) had to stand. It did not occur to us to look in the
"Independant" section. When looking for a clear breakdown of what
makes qualifies as a title, you wouldn't. The sentance under the
lexicon of votes (something about "other vampires may have votes
without titles") seemed to apply. Hence this thread.

Now, my playgroup are not stupid (all are well educated and in good
jobs, etc). We are, however, busy people who like V:TES, and don't
have time to search all the way through a rulebook. We like things
arranged sensibly. It would not hurt, surely, to move one sentance
from the arse end of the book to where it would probably be more
relevant.

If a vampire is being "treated as if it has a title", it does, to all
intents and purposes, have a title. Are there any examples of where
"treated as if..." titles have any benefit / detriment to a "real"
title? Not that I can think of. Sure, there aren't any "only playable
by an independant who has votes" cards I can think of, but that's
pretty much it. So if they are effectively titled, mention it in the
"Titles" section.

If nothing else, the fact that Indies with votes are not untitled
needs to be qualified in capitals for new players, since they are
going to see a lot of Anarch stuff at the moment.

> 6.3.4 was moved to its appropriate place in the rulebook.
> http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=dbIf9.391009%24me6.44814%40sccrnsc01

Yeah, great. I'm banging on about this because I feel strongly you
should change it, mainly becuase it wasted a goodly time of my evening
last week, and I suspect others may have similar rucks with the
holding of titles becoming ever more important, and the number of
titles growing with each expansion.

Regards

DH
